summary.intent: Implement SDK-based E2E and load test suites as two new workspace packages (tests/sdk-e2e and tests/load), replacing flaky Playwright browser automation with direct CipherBoxClient API calls, then debug and harden the implementation against rate limiting.
summary.outcome: All 83 SDK E2E tests pass against a local stack in ~11s. Both packages compile cleanly, a throttle bypass mechanism was implemented for staging/CI use, and a TESTING_STRATEGY.md document captures architectural decisions. PR #318 was created and updated.

repo: setApiClientConfig in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts is a module-level singleton because orval generates standalone functions that import customInstance globally — this causes cross-test contamination in multi-account scenarios and requires switchTo() hacks
The API uses per-controller @UseGuards(ThrottlerGuard) (not global APP_GUARD), with 10 req/s and 100 req/min limits — tight enough to block rapid SDK test suites
test-login endpoint has its own stricter throttle (5 per 15 min) separate from the general throttler
NestJS ConfigModule loads .env files which override process.env, so setting NODE_ENV=test in the shell doesn't work when .env has NODE_ENV=development
Pre-commit hooks enforce API client regeneration — modifying instance.ts requires running pnpm api:generate before committing
pnpm-workspace.yaml uses three groups: apps/*, packages/*, tests/* — new test packages must be added here and to release-please-config.json extra-files
The integration test at packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts lines 24-59 is the canonical prototype for the test-login → vault-init → CipherBoxClient pattern
CipherBoxClient exposes getFolderTree() as a public method — no need for (client as any).folderTree casts in test assertions
Invite claim DTO has @MinLength(258) on encryptedKey — dummy Uint8Array(64) only produces 128 hex chars, failing validation; real ECIES output via wrapKey() is required
The API's mock-ipns-routing service entry point is index.js (not server.js) and is pre-built at tests/e2e/mock-ipns-routing/

code.finding: Module-level _config singleton with setApiClientConfig/getApiClientConfig — adding optional defaultHeaders field allows injecting bypass headers into all axios requests automatically
ThrottlerModule.forRoot() uses ConfigService — NODE_ENV conditional here is the right place to widen limits for test environments, but the bypass guard approach is cleaner
Tests that run after multi-account suites need to re-call setApiClientConfig before any SDK operations, since multi-account fixtures overwrite the singleton

workflow: 1Password SSH agent for commit signing times out in background agent subprocesses — commits from background tasks may hang; foreground commits work fine
Running tsc --noEmit against a package that depends on a recently modified sibling requires rebuilding the sibling first (pnpm --filter <pkg> build)
When using sed for bulk replacements in test files, unmatched parens from partial replacements cause cascading syntax errors — better to rewrite the whole file
Vitest with fileParallelism: false runs suites sequentially in one process, meaning module-level singletons persist across all test files in a run

friction: setApiClientConfig singleton caused cross-suite test contamination — multi-account test suites overwrote the singleton, causing subsequent single-account tests to get 401s
API rate limiting (10 req/s, 100 req/min) blocked rapid SDK test suites immediately — required a full bypass guard implementation before tests could pass
NODE_ENV=test env var override didn't work because .env file loaded by ConfigModule takes precedence over shell environment
Bulk sed replacement of `headers: {` to `headers: fetchHeaders({` left unmatched closing parens, corrupting vault-lifecycle.test.ts and requiring a full file rewrite
Pre-commit hook required api:generate after modifying instance.ts — not obvious that hand-written files in api-client trigger regeneration checks
Background bash tasks hung waiting for 1Password SSH agent for commit signing, requiring manual intervention or retry
open_items: Refactor api-client from module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios — configure orval to generate functions accepting an axios instance parameter, thread through sdk-core SdkContext, have CipherBoxClient own its axios instance (todo captured in .planning/todos/pending/2026-03-22-refactor-api-client-from-singleton-to-instance-scoped-axios.md)
Migrate raw fetch() calls in vault-lifecycle, share-operations, and invite-link test suites to use generated API client functions — currently uses testFetch() wrapper as a stopgap
Load tests not yet validated against staging — upload-throughput, ipns-publish-storm, mixed-workload, sustained-load, and spike-test scenarios need a staging run
Throttle validation scenario needed — a load test that runs WITHOUT the bypass header to verify the throttler itself behaves correctly under load
Production load test strategy undefined — staging tests single-node perf, but horizontal scaling validation requires multi-IP distributed load against the actual cluster
